author: PC Gamer
text:
A hobby dev built a free, 3D galaxy map for Warhammer 40K that loads like lightning in your browser
I just think it's neat.

author: PC Gamer
text:
18 years after Metal Gear Solid 4 first launched, a modder has shown off its first custom map, MGS3's Groznyj Grad
Groznyj Grad? The mountain redoubt of GRU Colonel Volgin?

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker sold 1 million copies in just 3 days
None too shabby.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'There is absolutely no generative AI in Space Marine 3' promises Saber Interactive executive
The Machine Spirits lie silent.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Saber CCO Tim Willits is still bullish on AI, but concerned about its environmental impact: 'Elon wants to put servers in space. That could be the answer, right?'
"I mean, it's funny, but why not?"

author: PC Gamer
text:
Do you ever listen to videogame music in your day-to-day life?
Or should videogame music stay *inside* the game?

author: PC Gamer
text:
GSC Game World says there's a reason it didn't give Stalker 2 more time in the oven: 'To make something better, you need to receive feedback, and this feedback should be fresh'
"Every developer would like to have an infinite amount of time, but … the market state is not very promising."

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Halloween game has a sex minigame in it, except no it doesn't, because it was apparently removed
Some perverse pairings may be the culprit.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword proves the parry formula is far from stale, you just need to get freaky with it
Parry fatigue? Not me.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I never thought a fishing sim could be this fun, but How to Fish proves me wrong with its ridiculous physics, killer spider crabs, and classic co-op chaos
I now know How to Fish, kinda.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blending Deus Ex with Escape from Butcher Bay, Deficit is one of the best-feeling indie immersive sims I've played—even if the stealth system needs serious work
Playing the demo for Deficit was far from a net loss.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Here's 10 more minutes of the most interesting game shown at this year's Opening Night Live
Rat's entertainment.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Civilization 7 will finally enter the atomic age in 2027, via a free update Firaxis says will be 'even bigger in scope' than last year's Test of Time
First expansion "Earthrise" also announced.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ex-BioWare designer says doom and gloom about the next Mass Effect is overstated: 'I think that they can do it'
"I think BioWare can do it if we just leave them alone to do what they do best."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Peak studio Aggro Crab is publishing a sick-looking platformer about a blue collar guy doing dirty work on an alien world
That's what's up.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Saber CCO says the studio isn't changing up its comms strategy after recent controversies: 'There's always some dust up'
"The games will speak for themselves."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dwarf Fortress co-creator Tarn Adams was amazed other devs had heard of his game the first time he went to a convention: 'I didn't know that anyone knew what we were doing'
"I try to have good moral qualities, but I am apparently subject to all forms of flattery and vanity and such."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Go grandmaster becomes first human to win series against advanced AI engine in 3-hour match
We've still got some fight left in us.

author: PC Gamer
text:
8-year Old School RuneScape saga comes to a close with former dev sentenced for stealing $400K in gold and items from players
You ever just lose your 20s to a self-inflicted RuneScape legal saga.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Saber CCO Tim Willits blames layoffs on games industry overspecialization: 'Studios that have a couple hundred employees that work on one game are going to struggle'
"Why not take a risk?"
